thread:
emily: Customer reported large spike -> sustained 504s around 16:20 UTC for tenant `acme-inc`. High-level: gateway timed out waiting for inference workers. Escalating.

support-bot: New escalation created: INC-3241, severity=P1. Customer-facing note sent.

sasha: I'm seeing the gateway logs show upstream timeouts: `504 GET /v1/generate` with backend connection reset after ~30s.

matt: Can you paste the k8s pod counts for the tenant's pool? wondering if scaleout happened.

emily: Copied from control plane at 16:22:
```
TenantPool: acme-inc-pool
Desired: 0
Ready: 0
Allocating: 0
LastScaleEvent: 16:17:08
```
Seems like no capacity was allocated during the spike.

sasha: Oof. Looking at KEDA scaledobject for that pool — the trigger metric name doesn't match our queue metric exporter. ScaledObject uses `queue_length` but exporter is emitting `task_queue_messages`. KEDA poll didn't see metric -> no scale.

lee: That explains it. I also grabbed the scaledobject: 
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-inc-scaledobject
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: acme-inference-deployment
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://metrics-svc
      metricName: queue_length
      threshold: "10"
      query: sum(rate(queue_length[1m]))
```

matt: Meanwhile the deployment's readiness probe was set to run a model warmup that takes ~25s. With zero replicas, new pods initialize, run warmup (blocking readiness) and KEDA has short cooldown, so the gateway times out before pods become Ready.

ops_shawn: Found logs from a cold-start pod: 
```
[2026-03-15T16:18:12Z] INIT: pulling model redwood-tiny (1.4GB)
[2026-03-15T16:18:42Z] WARMUP: running tokenize/warmup loop (25s)
[2026-03-15T16:19:10Z] READINESS: not ready -> still warming
```
Gateway timed out at ~30s, so it occurred mid-warmup.

emily: Actionable short-term fixes?

sasha: 1) Update ScaledObject metricName and query to match exporter (`task_queue_messages`) and increase pollInterval to reduce detection lag.

lee: 2) Set scaleTarget minReplica > 0 for higher tiers or critical tenants (e.g., minReplicas: 1) to avoid cold-starts for premium customers.

matt: 3) Move long warmup off the readiness probe. Make readiness check lightweight (HTTP health) and run asynchronous background warmup once Ready. That allows traffic to route to pods and use in-pod graceful warmup endpoints.

ops_shawn: Draft patch for ScaledObject metadata: 
```yaml
triggers:
- type: prometheus
  metadata:
    serverAddress: http://metrics-svc
    metricName: task_queue_messages
    query: sum(rate(task_queue_messages[30s]))
    pollInterval: "15"
    cooldownPeriod: "60"
```

emily: Also suggested gateway fallback: add short-path fallback to a small cached model (redwood-tiny) if no Ready pods after 12s to reduce 504s; customer consent required.

sasha: Repro steps for eng to validate:
- Set tenant pool to minReplicas:0 and misconfigure scaledobject metricName -> trigger coldstart failure.
- Generate synthetic burst: loadtest w/ concurrency 150 for 60s.
- Observe no scale event within 30s and gateway 504s.

matt: I ran a dry run on staging with corrected metricName + pollInterval 15s + cooldown 60s and minReplicas 1 for tenant. Scale happened within ~9s and warmup completed without gateway 504.

lee: Who's taking the rollout? Need to coordinate with infra change window and notify support.

emily: I'll own coordinating with customer ops and sending a post-mortem once we have root cause.

ops_shawn: I'll prepare the k8s patch and a helm value for tenant pools: `minReplicas: 1` toggle per-tier + updated ScaledObject template.

sasha: I'll open PR with a migration: fix metricName, add pollInterval/cooldown defaults, include notes on recommended readiness pattern.

emily: Support asked for ETA. Ops_shawn?

ops_shawn: ETA: patch + canary deploy to staging in 2 hours, production roll in next 6 hours after validation. Noting risk: slightly higher idle cost for tenants we bump to minReplicas=1.

emily: Customer notified of temporary mitigation and ETA.

matt: Quick checklist for follow-up items (tracking INC-3241):
- [ ] PR to fix ScaledObject metric/query (sasha)
- [ ] Helm chart update for minReplicas toggle (ops_shawn)
- [ ] Readiness probe refactor guidance + example (lee)
- [ ] Gateway fallback design doc (emily)
- [ ] Post-mortem and customer-impact summary (emily)

lee: One more note: long model pulls can fail if image registry throttles. Consider pre-pulling for high-tier tenants during low-traffic windows.

sasha: Added follow-up: instrument per-tenant scale latency metric and an alert when scale latency > 12s for > 3 mins.

emily: Great. Closing loop: assigned tasks and customer updated. Will post final incident summary when done. :white_check_mark:
